# Dynamics 365 frame machine

A local-first simulated CRM, not a connection to a live Dynamics tenant.
Pages base (primary): https://kody-w.github.io/localFirstTools
Raw base (cross-origin fallback): https://raw.githubusercontent.com/kody-w/localFirstTools/main
Registry: https://kody-w.github.io/localFirstTools/data/frame-machines/dynamics365/registry.json
Frames: https://kody-w.github.io/localFirstTools/data/frame-machines/dynamics365/api/v1/frames.json
Status: https://kody-w.github.io/localFirstTools/data/frame-machines/dynamics365/api/v1/status.json
Badge: https://kody-w.github.io/localFirstTools/data/frame-machines/dynamics365/api/v1/badge.json
Orientation: https://kody-w.github.io/localFirstTools/data/frame-machines/dynamics365/orient.json

- machine: https://kody-w.github.io/localFirstTools/data/frame-machines/dynamics365/machine.json
  Immutable fallback: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/kody-w/localFirstTools/main/data/frame-machines/dynamics365/versions/machine/9b9bf26bb31d.json
- overlay: https://kody-w.github.io/localFirstTools/data/frame-machines/dynamics365/active-system-data.json
  Immutable fallback: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/kody-w/localFirstTools/main/data/frame-machines/dynamics365/versions/overlay/e850ddf2653c.json
- liquid: https://kody-w.github.io/localFirstTools/data/frame-machines/dynamics365/liquid-dimension.json
  Immutable fallback: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/kody-w/localFirstTools/main/data/frame-machines/dynamics365/versions/liquid/04c11cfe4d3c.json
- chain: https://kody-w.github.io/localFirstTools/data/frame-machines/dynamics365/chain.jsonl
  Immutable fallback: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/kody-w/localFirstTools/main/data/frame-machines/dynamics365/versions/chain/4d6f53ce5766.jsonl

Verify SHA-256 bytes against registry entries (sha8 is 12 hex digits).
The chain uses rapp/1 body.pulse; prev links to the prior payload_hash.
Rebuild offline with python3 build.py; the three source JSON files stay unchanged.
